title: RSVP with flankers - sentences with semantic and syntactic violations
description: This dataset contains EEG recordings from an RSVP-with-flankers reading paradigm examining sentences with semantic and syntactic violations. Participants viewed 180 sentences containing subject-verb agreement, semantic, double, and word-order violations, as well as correct control sentences, while EEG was recorded to study neural responses to linguistic violations. Data were collected at San Diego State University's NeuroCognition Laboratory.
methods_description: Participants sat in a darkened, sound-attenuated room viewing an LCD monitor at 60 in (152 cm). Sentences were presented using an RSVP-with-flankers design, with three words shown simultaneously in the center of the screen; each word appeared for 400ms before sliding right and being replaced by the next word, with no ISI. Stimuli included 30 subject-verb agreement violations, 30 semantic violations, 30 double violations, 30 word-order violations, and 60 control sentences.
